thought.text: Sekarang saya uji langsung ke halaman yang benar-benar memvalidasi. Google punya endpoint test reCAPTCHA v3 yang menampilkan skor.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && K="cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b"; R=$(curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST https://api.capbypass.pro/createTask -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"clientKey\":\"$K\",\"task\":{\"type\":\"ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess\",\"websiteURL\":\"https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-request-scores.php\",\"websiteKey\":\"6LdKlZEpAAAAAAAdg0Gk0Jk2q0Fq2a0y0e0c0b0d0\",\"pageAction\":\"homepage\"}}"); echo "create: $(echo $R|head -c 160)"; echo "=== ambil sitekey asli dari halaman demo ==="; curl -s --max-time 25 "https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-request-scores.php" | grep -oE 'render=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+|data-sitekey="[^"]+"|sitekey=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+' | sort -u | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && K=\"cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b\"; R=$(curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST https://api.capbypass.pro/createTask -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"{\\\"clientKey\\\":\\\"$K\\\",\\\"task\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess\\\",\\\"websiteURL\\\":\\\"https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-request-scores.php\\\",\\\"websiteKey\\\":\\\"6LdKlZEpAAAAAAAdg0Gk0Jk2q0Fq2a0y0e0c0b0d0\\\",\\\"pageAction\\\":\\\"homepage\\\"}}\"); echo \"create: $(echo $R|head -c 160)\"; echo \"=== ambil sitekey asli dari halaman demo ===\"; curl -s --max-time 25 \"https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-request-scores.php\" | grep -oE 'render=[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+|data-sitekey=\"[^\"]+\"|sitekey=[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+' | sort -u | head", "summary": "Get real sitekey from reCAPTCHA demo page", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 90}
